system.description:
Action
Ritual · 1 minute
SP
2
Attribute
None
Range
One open square within 3 squares
Duration
1 hour, with commands

Shape a spectral riding horse using the Warhorse summoned profile. Give its immediate Main command. Continue directing it through the normal command procedure; movement carries its rider using the ordinary mounted movement rules and six-square tether.
